one_line: A three-step screen recording of the order, then a child's reaction, then one comment word that delivers the offer.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 top-down printed book with the MeBook logo and "ספר בהתאמה אישית"; 0:01 a toddler on a bed turns a book's pages. Voiceover (transcript): "קבלו רעיון למתנה המושלמת". Card at 0:03: "ספר שבו ילדיכם הם גיבורי העלילה".
q1_hook.why: The first sentence offers a gift idea and a clear promise, the child as hero, over a printed book and a real child (H1, H2, K7). The first frame is a logo cover, a little brand-heavy (H3), and no face speaks (H4).

beats.what: Printed book with the logo; a toddler turns a book's pages; "ספר שבו ילדיכם הם גיבורי העלילה"
beats.why: Gift promise, product and a real child within 3 s

beats.what: Zooms over illustrated covers and pages; "הקסם נוצר!" with a sparkle at 0:06
beats.why: Shows the finished look first, with an effect on the "magic" line

beats.what: Screen recording: photo crop, theme picker, cover picker; "בוחרים נושא לסיפור"
beats.why: Three steps show how little effort it takes

beats.what: Screen recording: page preview and text editor; "ואני חייבת להודות שזה ממש דומה למקור"
beats.why: Editing and likeness, the buyer's doubts, in one stretch

beats.what: A toddler on a bed receives the book; the dedication page; "בחיי ששווה הכל!"
beats.why: The reaction shot is the emotional centre

beats.what: Two children read in bed; "אז תכירו את" and the MeBook name; a glowing illustrated boy
beats.why: The brand is named after the steps and the reaction

beats.what: A man and a toddler read in bed, then a woman with two children; "זיכרון משפחתי"
Illustrated girl with bunnies; "לפרטים נוספים והטבה שווה קפצו לתיאור!"
beats.why: The ask comes last, after the warmth

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Caption: comment the word "מיבוק" to get a coupon code by message. The video says to jump to the description. Nothing asks to send or save.
q2_flow.why: A promise first, three ordering steps, then a child's reaction and a family line make a full arc (K2, H2). The screen recordings carry the information (R3). The emotional shots sit in the last third and lead into the CTA (R4).

q3_cta.what: Spoken (transcript) and on screen 0:32 to 0:34: "לפרטים נוספים והטבה שווה קפצו לתיאור!" with down arrows. Caption: "להטבה שווה רשמו בתגובה ״מיבוק״ ותקבלו קוד קופון ישירות אליכם"; last line "בשיתוף ממומן @mebook.ai".
q3_cta.why: A comment word that delivers a concrete thing, a coupon code by message (C3, R6); the video points to the description and the caption holds the word (C6). One goal but two routes, and the on-screen line says "jump to the description", not the word (C1).

q4_shown.what: Printed books and illustrated covers (0:00 to 0:07); a screen recording of the order steps (0:08 to 0:20); children receiving and reading printed books in bed (0:21 to 0:32); a dedication page (0:24). No price, and no photo beside an illustration.
q4_shown.why: The screen recording shows the personalising steps (S8), and a child's reaction at 0:21 gives the emotional proof (K8). The main doubt, does it look like my child, rests on the spoken "שזה ממש דומה למקור" over an illustration, with no photo beside it (S2 not met). Children's faces are shown (S5).

q5_edit.what: About 25 to 30 shots in 34 s, mostly 1 to 2 s, with two screen recordings of 6 to 12 s. Zooms and a sparkle at 0:06. Subtitles change every 1 to 3 s. Ends on an illustrated card with the CTA.
q5_edit.why: Cuts every 1 to 2 s, zooms and a sparkle at the magic line keep the start lively (E1, E2), and the screen recordings steady the middle (R3). The child's reaction gets only about 3 s before cutting on (E2). It ends on the CTA card, no tail (E8).

q6_topic.what: A gift idea: a printed or digital book where the child is the hero, ordered in three steps online. Serves parents and relatives looking for a personal gift.
q6_topic.why: A gift frame names a buying moment and a buyer, a parent or relative (K7, R5). The emotional centre is a child receiving the book, with a family-memory line (K1, K8). The video names no occasion, only "gift"; the caption adds a first-grade book (K7).

q7_filmed.what: Mixed: handheld phone footage of children on a hotel-style bed in window and lamp light, top-down shots of printed books on a wooden table, two phone screen recordings, and full-screen illustrations. A man's and a woman's faces appear at 0:29 to 0:32.
q7_filmed.why: Real children on a bed read as home footage (H8, F7), and the printed books are shot top-down (F5). The screen recording fills the frame with large readable steps (F4). The mix of illustrations, screens and a fast montage reads as an ad template, not one parent's video (H8).

q8_text.on_screen: Bold white and yellow subtitles with a black outline, two or three lines, moving between top, middle and lower thirds: "ספר שבו ילדיכם הם גיבורי העלילה" (0:03), "הקסם נוצר!" (0:06), "בוחרים נושא לסיפור ויש מלא אופציות!" (0:09), "ואני חייבת להודות שזה ממש דומה למקור" (0:20), "ומייצרים זיכרון משפחתי שיישאר איתכם לשנים רבות!" (0:29), "לפרטים נוספים והטבה שווה קפצו לתיאור!" (0:33). Logo at 0:00 and 0:26.
q8_text.caption: "תכירו את המתנה המושלמת 🎁". About 120 words: product claim, a three-step list, delivery by WhatsApp, a first-grade bonus fact, the comment-word ask, last line "בשיתוף ממומן @mebook.ai". No hashtags.
q8_text.why: Big outlined subtitles carry the whole voiceover for a muted viewer (T1), but they wander between top, middle and lower thirds, some in the top 14% or bottom 35% (T4), and the 0:03 card stays about 1.5 s for 31 characters (T5). The caption's disclosure is its last line (T8).

weak_points: A fast montage with several image types reads as a template; the brand is spoken only at 0:25; the likeness proof is a spoken claim over an illustration; text moves and sits at the edges; two routes in the CTA.
lumebook_takeaway: Film the order steps as one phone screen recording, add one top-down shot of the printed book in hands, and end with one comment-word CTA that delivers the link.
not_verified: Music (cannot hear). The coupon code and how it is delivered. Whether the boy photo in the crop at 0:08 is the boy of the astronaut illustration at 0:07 (consecutive, never side by side). The transcript has a gap at 26 to 30 s; text was read from the frames. Corrections to src/coded: frames show two children (a girl and a boy) repeated across the Reel plus a man and a woman, not several different children; the first subtitle is at 0:01; the brand is spoken at 0:24 to 0:26.
